tagline: 奥林巴斯无反相机，2011 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2011年推出的无反相机。配备Micro Four Thirds System mount。快门速度1/4,000 to 60 s, 30 minutes bulb。

specs.传感器: Four Thirds System 18.00 × 13.50 mm (17.30 × 13.00 mm imaging area) Live MOS
specs.闪光灯: Built-in pop up, TTL, GN 10.5m equivalent (ISO100 · m); hotshoe for external flash attachment
specs.曝光测光: Digital ESP metering, Centre weighted average metering, Spot metering
specs.取景器: live preview, optional electronic viewfinder VF-2; optional electronic viewfinder VF-3; optional optical viewfinder VF-1
specs.屏幕: 3" 614K dots OLED LCD on screen with live preview with capacitive touchscreen control
specs.电池: Olympus BLS-1 or BLS-5 Lithium-ion battery
specs.重量: (body only) (body, battery and SD memory card)
